outcome.outcome: More therapies evaluated per year, without a matching rise in cost or patient burden. Promising candidates stop dying in the queue.
outcome.rationale: Their description names cost, timeline and scarcity together, and their capability list is dominated by trial-design and recruitment tools.

ai_types.rationale: Trial design, participant matching and prioritisation are optimisation problems over explicit objectives.
Digital twins, synthetic control arms and proxy biomarkers are prediction problems, and all appear in their capability list.

measurability.rationale: Cost per trial, enrolment time and trials completed per year are recorded in registries.

outcome.outcome: Drugs fail cheaply on the bench instead of expensively in late-stage trials, because preclinical results start predicting human outcomes.
outcome.rationale: Their description ties model inadequacy directly to costly drug-development failures in clinical trials.

ai_types.rationale: Organoids, ex vivo organs and novel research models are engineered biological systems designed against a fidelity objective. The taxonomy has no clean category for wet-lab model-system engineering, so this is the nearest fit.
Computational physiology models are the alternative route to the same predictive-validity goal.

measurability.rationale: The share of preclinical successes that survive to clinical success is a direct, historically tracked translation rate.

outcome.outcome: Follow health trajectories across decades and diverse populations. Developmental and environmental causes stop being inferred from cross-sections.
outcome.rationale: Their description names developmental, nutritional and environmental influences on long-term outcomes as the target.

ai_types.rationale: Cohort access, biobank expansion and sustained multi-decade follow-up are funding and governance problems, not measurement ones.
Easy longitudinal sampling depends on low-burden assays, which is a working detection capability.

measurability.rationale: Cohort size, years of follow-up, retention and demographic representativeness are direct and reported.

outcome.outcome: Multifactorial disease and ageing get identified causal mechanisms rather than correlates, which makes them targetable the way single-cause diseases already are.
outcome.rationale: Their description contrasts diseases with well-defined root causes, which were cured, against multifactorial ones, which were not.

ai_types.rationale: Their framing requires modulating multiple mechanisms simultaneously, which is a combinatorial screen far beyond manual throughput.
Better systems measurements and resolved brain-body mapping are detection capabilities their list names directly.

measurability.rationale: Biomarkers and intervention effects are measurable, but the underlying causal structure of a multifactorial disease is inferred from those proxies rather than observed.

outcome.outcome: Payloads reach the tissue they are aimed at, the brain included, so what can be delivered stops limiting what can be treated.
outcome.rationale: Their description names off-target accumulation and brain delivery as the specific failures.

ai_types.rationale: Delivery vehicle and targeting-ligand design is a search against a measurable biodistribution objective.

measurability.rationale: Percent of injected dose reaching target tissue versus liver and other off-target organs is a direct, standard biodistribution readout.

outcome.outcome: ADME and toxicity failures show up before dosing rather than in clinical trials.
outcome.rationale: Their description names ADME/Tox failures as the dominant cause of drug development failure.

ai_types.rationale: ADME and toxicity prediction is a supervised problem with large existing labelled datasets, and most of their ten capabilities are mapping or prediction work.

measurability.rationale: Prediction accuracy against measured pharmacokinetics and observed clinical toxicity is directly scorable on held-out compounds.

notes: Second instance of the same taxonomy strain seen in chemistry and computation: engineering a biological model system is neither design search nor physical build as defined. Flagged as a guess.
